title: Grateful Dead Live at Hampton Coliseum on 1988-03-27
lineage: The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
source: 2 Nakamichi CM100/CP1 X-Y@90degrees 1 Nakamichi CM300/CP2 Nakamichi 550 w/Dolby B in OTS. Sony UX Pro 90 cassettes. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes.

ai_review.summary: A memorable To Lay Me Down breakout makes this show shine, though the recording source and fidelity are unspecified.
ai_review.review: The crowd went wild for the To Lay Me Down breakout, and many listeners recall it as one of Jerry Garcia’s finest ballad performances alongside Comes A Time. No details about the tape source or sound quality were provided, but the enthusiastic fan rating (4 stars) indicates a generally positive listening experience.
